subject: Manager handoff and confidentiality plan for conduct case
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Confidential: concern reported by Acme contact

Forwarding a confidential report we received from Acme. I removed identifying vendor PII from the attached PDF. Jessica asked that this be handled discreetly.

-----Original Message-----
From: Jessica White <jessica.white@acme.com>
Sent: Thu, 28 May 2026 08:03:21 -0700
To: security@redwood.com
Subject: Concern about team member behavior

Hi Redwood team,

I need to report a sensitive issue observed during an integration workshop last week. A Redwood engineer made repeated remarks that made several of our team uncomfortable; two people asked to step out. We are happy to provide a brief statement or participate in an interview. We value discretion — please do not share identities beyond HR/legal.

Thanks,
Jessica White
Senior Program Manager, Acme Corp

Attachments: acme_statement_redacted.pdf

Monica
HR Intake
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>; Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Confidential: concern reported by Acme contact

Thanks Monica — I reviewed the forwarded note. I can take the manager handoff and coordinate next steps with Hannah (direct manager) and HR. Proposed immediate actions: 

- Temporary reassignment of the implicated engineer from client-facing work for the next 7 days.
- Schedule separate interviews with the two Acme contacts (Jessica + backup) and a private interview with the engineer.
- Preserve Slack and meeting recordings; do not attempt to collect screenshots from personal devices.
- Run a short, leader-only confidentiality reminder to the team (no names or details).

Questions for HR/legal: do we need a formal legal hold before collecting the Slack export? Lauren, can you confirm.

I will not discuss specifics with the team until we align. I will aim to confirm the reassignment by EOD.

—Markus
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager handoff and confidentiality plan for conduct case

Agree with the plan. HR will:

- Open a confidential case file (HR-1423) and attach Acme's statement.
- Collect and redact any PII in attachments.
- Export Slack channel history for the relevant channel (timestamps provided by Markus) and put it on secure HR Drive.
- Set calendar holds for interviews (we will use private slots, opt-in only for participants).

Please avoid telling the team about the reassignment beyond this: 
"Leadership is making a short, precautionary reallocation of duties while HR conducts a review."

Attached: timeline_redacted.pdf (internal evidence summary).

Monica Patel
Senior HR Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Manager notes and availability

Thanks for looping me in. Quick manager notes attached (manager_notes.docx) — includes my observations from last week's workshop and a short timeline from our internal meeting.

Availability for interviews: Tue 6/1 10:00-12:00 or Wed 6/2 14:00-16:00. I will follow Monica's suggested message language when asked about the reassignment.

I want to emphasize: I will not discuss details with the team or the engineer beyond the safety-focused reassignment. Please tell me if Legal needs anything else preserved.

—Hannah
Engineering Manager

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Legal hold and preservation steps

Agree with the interim steps. Legal requests the following immediate actions to preserve privilege and meet compliance: 

- Issue a legal hold to the implicated engineer (cc: legal) and preserve their corporate device images if needed.
- Preserve the Slack export that HR will generate and keep it on a restricted drive.
- Do not forward external statements or Acme attachments outside HR/Legal/Markus.

I created ticket HR-1423 in our tracker and added a legal-hold checklist (link below). If you are asked by Acme's legal team, route all requests through me (acme-legal@acme.com is on copy of the original report).

Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-1423

Lauren Bishop
Deputy General Counsel

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>; Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager handoff and confidentiality plan for conduct case

Thanks team — confirmation and next steps: 

Action items (assigned):
- Markus: implement 7-day reassignment for engineer (effective immediately), block client-facing calendar invites, confirm with IT to begin a secure Slack export. (Due: 2026-06-01 18:00 PT)
- Monica: send interview invites to Acme contacts and internal attendees; upload redacted docs to secure HR Drive. (Due: 2026-06-02 12:00 PT)
- Lauren: legal hold issued and checklist applied; available if Acme legal contacts us. (Due: 2026-06-01 20:00 PT)
- Hannah: provide manager notes and be present for internal interview; lead team confidentiality reminder once aligned with HR. (Due: 2026-06-02 09:00 PT)

I will not discuss identifying details with the broader team. If anyone needs to escalate to Execs, please loop in Monica and Lauren first.

Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships (acting)
